answer: Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Mottobound herald limner tabard bond sees to it, since a bond herald limners lodge after herald office checks. Each name is charged a toll of 68 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Every glacier is counted once. The mesa is checked, not assumed. The summit is on the docket.
